Bring your bills into focus.

Download your Green Button XML from Hydro Ottawa, then choose it here. Files are processed on your device.

Open Hydro Ottawa’s download instructions ↗

CSV columns: start,end,kwh,total. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts: CAD. Blank usage or total is allowed.

Green Button files vary. Review imported amounts against your bill before comparing. Usage-only interval files are identified separately and are not treated as bill totals.
